SELECT Citizenship, COUNT(*) AS count FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.Title, sg.Name FROM song s JOIN singer sg ON s.Singer_ID = sg.Singer_ID;
SELECT s.Title, sg.Name FROM "song" AS s JOIN "singer" AS sg ON s.Singer_ID = sg.Singer_ID;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer s
JOIN song so ON s.Singer_ID = so.Singer_ID
WHERE so.Sales > 300000;
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM singer s JOIN song so ON s.Singer_ID = so.Singer_ID WHERE so.Sales > 300000;

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s
JOIN song so ON s.Singer_ID = so.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID
HAVING COUNT(so.Song_ID) > 1;
SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM song GROUP BY Singer_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

SELECT s.Name, SUM(so.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
LEFT JOIN song so ON s.Singer_ID = so.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID;

SELECT s.Name, SUM(so.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song so ON s.Singer_ID = so.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID;

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM song so
    WHERE so.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
);

SELECT s.Name AS sname
FROM singer s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM song so 
    WHERE so.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
);
SELECT Citizenship FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year < 1945 AND Birth_Year > 1955;
SELECT DISTINCT Citizenship FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year < 1945 AND Birth_Year > 1955;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_features FROM `Other_Available_Features`;

SELECT ft.`feature_type_name` 
FROM `Other_Available_Features` OFA
JOIN `Ref_Feature_Types` ft ON OFA.`feature_type_code` = ft.`feature_type_code`
WHERE LOWER(OFA.`feature_name`) = LOWER('AirCon');

SELECT property_name
FROM Properties
WHERE LOWER(property_type_code) IN ('house', 'apartment')
AND room_count > 1;
